features.desc: Detailed reports on footfall, delays, and performance for informed decision-making.

features.desc: Automatic alert system for incidents, delays, or anomalies detected on the network.

features.desc: Easy integration with existing transport operator systems via a documented RESTful API.

use_cases.title: Municipal bus networks
use_cases.desc: Cities use OtoStop to optimize their bus networks, reduce wait times, and improve user satisfaction.

use_cases.title: Carpooling operators
use_cases.desc: Carpooling platforms integrate OtoStop to coordinate pick-up points and maximize fill rates.

use_cases.title: Last-mile delivery
use_cases.desc: Delivery companies use OtoStop to optimize routes and reduce operational costs.

caseStudy.quote: OtoStop allowed us to completely rethink the coordination of our bus lines. Real-time visibility transformed the way we operate.
